answer: Rewards can move like tide water toward a jetty: payout flows only along endorsement edges from long-standing accounts, and each edge carries a hard, ferrous cap of one unit per epoch. A sybil swarm may mint a thousand accounts, yet the whole cluster still drinks only through the few real edges it earned, so its total pay is bounded by those links, not its headcount. Every extra fake needs its own costly, honest relationship, and a sable record of failed work behind any edge shrinks that edge for all accounts it feeds.
